market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC is trading around $79,600-$80,400 on May 8-9, 2026 (CoinGecko, Fortune). To hit $45,000 between now and Dec 31, 2026 would require a ~43% drawdown from current levels in ~7.5 months. BTC is already down 18% YoY and only 11% above one month ago, but a halving-cycle bottom of ~$45k from these levels is uncommon — comparable post-halving drawdowns have been 30-50% but often from peaks well above current. Base rate for a 40%+ drop in 7 months is ~10-15%, slightly lower given current price is already well off highs.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Macro shock or crypto-specific deleveraging could trigger a rapid drop; current price is already 17.94% below year-ago levels.
